name: PocketLog: Personal Finance
shortDescription: A modern, 100% offline-first personal finance application for Android. Built with Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Clean Architecture, and Room, featuring deterministic ledger reconciliation, multi-account & multi-currency tracking (14 currencies), cash flow analytics, and optional user-directed Google Drive private backups.
longDescription: PocketLog is a lightweight, 100% offline-first personal finance and habit tracking application for Android. Architected with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and Clean Architecture + MVVM, PocketLog operates with deterministic ledger balance reconciliation across multiple accounts (Cash, Bank, Mobile Wallet, Credit Card, Savings, Investments). It supports 14 world currencies with automated daily exchange rate sync and cross-currency transfers, monthly and category budgets with proactive alerts, native A4 PDF monthly report generation, biometric/PIN security, and optional user-directed Google Drive AppData private cloud backups.

problemsSolved.title: Logging Friction & Speed
problemsSolved.description: Standard personal finance apps suffer from tedious transaction entry. PocketLog eliminates logging friction with an intuitive quick-entry interface that caches and pre-fills last-used amounts and units for each category.

problemsSolved.title: Single-Account & Currency Limitations
problemsSolved.description: Most lightweight budget trackers restrict users to a single account or currency. PocketLog supports multi-account tracking across 6 distinct account types and 14 world currencies with automated daily exchange rate sync.

problemsSolved.title: Historical Ledger Corruption on Currency Changes
problemsSolved.description: Mutating an account's currency directly breaks historical bookkeeping. PocketLog implements an audited Account Currency Conversion flow that creates the target account, transfers the converted balance, and safely archives the source account.

problemsSolved.title: Cloud Privacy & Data Ownership Concerns
problemsSolved.description: Modern financial tools frequently transmit sensitive records to external cloud servers and ad brokers. PocketLog operates 100% locally with zero tracking SDKs, device-level biometric lock, and user-directed Google Drive AppData private cloud backups.

highlights: 100% Offline-first core personal financial tracking with deterministic ledger balance reconciliation.
Multi-account management across Cash, Bank, Mobile Wallet, Credit Card, Savings, and Investments.
14 world currencies supported with automated daily exchange rate updates and cross-currency transfers.
Audited Account Currency Conversion flow (creates target account, transfers balance, and archives source account).
Monthly & category budgets with 80%/100% alerts and daily safe burn allowance.
Cash flow analytics, net savings rate, and native A4 PDF monthly report export.
Optional user-directed Google Drive App Data private cloud backup & restore (GZIP + SHA-256 integrity).
Biometric / PIN app lock with 30-second background grace period.
English & Bangla dual-language support with 100% string parity and native Bangla numeral formatting.

challenges.title: Deterministic Cross-Currency Transfers & Historical Ledger Integrity
challenges.solution: Modeled transfers with atomic two-sided debit/credit entries storing source amount, destination amount in minor units, and agreed exchange rate (fxRateSource). Implemented an audited account conversion flow that creates a target account, transfers balance, and safely archives the source account.

challenges.title: Tamper-Resistant Cloud Backups with Strict Privacy Scopes
challenges.solution: Integrated Google Drive REST API v3 using the restricted drive.appdata scope. PocketLog isolates compressed Gzip backups in the user's hidden AppData folder with SHA-256 integrity verification, ensuring zero access to personal drive files.

challenges.title: Zero-Library Native A4 PDF Report Generation & Number Localization
challenges.solution: Built a custom native Canvas renderer using Android's PdfDocument API. Incorporated a locale string-filtering mapper that translates English numeral characters into native Bangla equivalents (০-৯) before drawing to Canvas, and exposed reports securely via androidx.core.content.FileProvider.

challenges.title: Resilient Exact-Time Reminders Across System Reboots
challenges.solution: Registered a BootReceiver to capture the system's ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED broadcast. When triggered, it reads saved reminder preferences from local settings and schedules a new exact alarm using Hilt-injected schedulers, surviving device restarts.

name: Trade Memo
tagline: The Anti-Tilt Journal in Your Pocket.
shortDescription: An Android-first, local-first behavioral trading companion designed to eliminate emotional indiscipline and execution drift. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, and Room KMP, it enables rapid trade logging in under 30 seconds, tracks execution discipline via Process Scores, and quantifies the financial impact of emotional errors (Avoidable Loss).
longDescription: Trade Memo is a native Android-first, local-first behavioral execution journal designed to combat the primary cause of retail trader failure: emotional indiscipline, revenge trading, and execution drift. Departing from complex desktop accounting ledgers and fragile broker API syncs, Trade Memo serves as an 'Anti-Tilt Pocket Coach.' Discretionary crypto and futures traders can record trades in under 30 seconds, measure rule compliance with a 3-point execution checkpoint, and isolate normal system drawdowns from self-inflicted Avoidable Loss. Operating 100% locally with an on-device Room KMP SQLite database and an AMOLED Obsidian Terminal interface, sensitive trading records stay strictly on-device.

problemsSolved.title: The 14-Day Journaling Abandonment Cliff
problemsSolved.description: Standard trading journals require 15–25 cumbersome form fields and take 1–3 minutes per trade, causing traders to abandon journaling during drawdowns. Trade Memo solves this with a single-screen rapid entry flow completed in under 30 seconds.

problemsSolved.title: The 'Coroner' Journal Syndrome
problemsSolved.description: Conventional platforms perform autopsies on blown accounts by plotting retrospective P&L curves without addressing real-time discipline. Trade Memo calculates Avoidable Loss to explicitly separate healthy system losses from emotional errors like FOMO and moving stop-losses.

problemsSolved.title: Broker Sync Fragility & Privacy Risks
problemsSolved.description: Over 80% of competitor 1-star complaints stem from broken third-party broker API integrations and cloud sync mismatches. Trade Memo adopts a reliable, 100% local-first on-device Room KMP database with zero server lock-in and complete offline privacy.

highlights: Rapid Trade Entry (<30s) — Single-screen ergonomic logging with quick-tap asset chips, Long/Short toggle, and automatic R-multiple calculations.
Avoidable Loss & Process Engine — Clearly separates strategic system losses from emotional discipline slips (FOMO, oversized entries, moved stop-losses).
Planned vs. Actual Checkpoint — Binary 3-point post-trade review verifying price entry discipline, stop-loss adherence, and strategy exit targets.
High-Contrast Visual Calendar — Monthly calendar grid with color-coded session P&L pills, trade counts, and daily journal breakdown.
Obsidian Terminal Design — Fluid native Compose Multiplatform interface adhering to an 8dp precision grid and dark AMOLED aesthetics.
100% Local-First Data Engine — On-device Room KMP SQLite storage with complete offline functionality and full CSV data export.

challenges.title: Eliminating broker API fragility without introducing manual friction
challenges.solution: Rejected high-maintenance third-party broker API syncs in favor of an ergonomic Compose Multiplatform bottom sheet with quick asset chips, custom financial keypad, and automated P&L / R-multiple calculations, achieving trade entry in under 30 seconds.

challenges.title: Mathematical quantification of System Loss vs. Avoidable Emotional Loss
challenges.solution: Engineered a deterministic behavioral scoring engine that cross-references defined golden rules and trade checkpoints against actual execution, isolating strategy variance from behavioral slips and computing an actionable Process Score (0–100%).

challenges.title: Zero-cloud local persistence across multiplatform targets
challenges.solution: Architected the storage layer using AndroidX Room KMP and Multiplatform DataStore to store trade logs, screenshots, and golden rules entirely on-device, eliminating cloud server dependencies and ensuring complete offline reliability.

challenges.title: Lightweight high-performance charting on 120Hz mobile displays
challenges.solution: Implemented custom Compose Canvas lightweight drawing layers for calendar pills and performance trajectories, eliminating heavy third-party charting libraries while preserving fluid 120fps scrolling on AMOLED displays.
